Build a Concentric Signal joined through a hollow TSV, with separate top and
bottom Ground planes connected by four Ground TSVs. This notebook inspects the
Q3D model and Net assignments; it does **not** extract a capacitance matrix.
See the [TSV model-inspection guide](../../../../simulation/tsv-model-inspection.qmd)
and [capacitance requirement](../../../../simulation/requirements/electrostatic-capacitance.qmd).

Use this OrPen source candidate with the fixed
[SCGSim checkpoint](https://github.com/OrPenStrike/scgsim/tree/c9270c7e76e0b2df187dddde462079e00d410dd0)
in an isolated Python 3.12/3.13 environment. AEDT 2024 R2 and the checkpoint's
PyAEDT 1.3.0 cohort are needed only for the explicit native transaction.
Ordinary project dependency pins are not changed by this notebook.

## Setup and Imports

The following cells use public OrPen source and SCGSim models. No Desktop opens
during imports or source authoring.

## Setup and Run Controls

`source` constructs the layout and source records only. `prepare_handoff`
creates a fresh backend input package; `build_model` additionally opens an owned
Desktop, builds, saves and releases the model. `inspect_model` reads only an
explicit returned run in a fresh kernel. No action here performs Analyze.

```{python}
#| id: tsv-q3d-controls
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from dataclasses import replace
from importlib.metadata import version
from pathlib import Path
from uuid import uuid4

from IPython.display import display
from scgsim.aedt import PdkMaterial, prepare_q3d_from_geometry, resolve_prepared_model
from scgsim.geometry import (
    GeometryBuildInput,
    GeometryPlanSnapshot,
    LayoutPolygonSpec,
    SemanticEntitySpec,
)

import orpen_sc_pdk
from orpen_sc_pdk.cells import get_tsv_source_records, tsv_concentric_signal_coupon

WORKFLOW_ACTION = "source"  # source | prepare_handoff | build_model | inspect_model
DIE = "D0"
DIE_SIDE_UM = 1000.0
BORE_DIAMETER_UM = 60.0
WALL_THICKNESS_UM = 0.2
SIGNAL_OUTER_RADIUS_UM = 100.0
GAP_UM = 20.0
GROUND_TSV_OFFSET_UM = 300.0
MODEL = "thin_film"  # face films become sheets; TSV levels remain retained_solid.
RUN_CONTROL = None
RUN_ID = f"tsv-concentric-q3d-{uuid4().hex[:12]}"
OUTPUT_ROOT = Path(".artifacts/SCGSimExamples/TSV")
RUN_DIR = OUTPUT_ROOT / RUN_ID
SOURCE_DIR = OUTPUT_ROOT / f"{RUN_ID}-source"
RETURNED_RUN_DIR = None  # Set to the actual returned run when selecting inspect_model.
PROJECT_NAME = "TSVConcentricQ3DThinFilmModelOnly"
DESIGN_NAME = "Q3D"
REGION_PADDING_XYZ_UM = (250.0, 250.0, 1000.0)
RESOURCES = None  # No solver HPC request; model-process allocation is arranged separately.
SIGNAL_ENTITY_IDS = (f"{DIE}/TOP_SIGNAL", f"{DIE}/BOTTOM_SIGNAL", f"{DIE}/SIGNAL_WALL")
GROUND_ENTITY_IDS = (f"{DIE}/TOP_GROUND", f"{DIE}/BACK_GROUND") + tuple(
    f"{DIE}/GROUND_TSV_{i}" for i in range(4)
)
orpen_sc_pdk.activate()
display({name: version(name) for name in ("orpen-sc-pdk", "gdsfactory", "scgsim")})
```

Solver resource flags are not an aggregate OS cap or CAD containment mechanism.
Execute a native action only under the available host allocation. Q3D has no
HFSS port or radiation boundary in this case. Source/Sink terminals are not
added to this terminal-free C/G model.

## Create Simulation Component / Coupon

```{python}
#| id: tsv-q3d-coupon
if WORKFLOW_ACTION != "inspect_model":
    coupon = tsv_concentric_signal_coupon(
        die=DIE,
        die_side_um=DIE_SIDE_UM,
        bore_diameter_um=BORE_DIAMETER_UM,
        wall_thickness_um=WALL_THICKNESS_UM,
        signal_outer_radius_um=SIGNAL_OUTER_RADIUS_UM,
        gap_um=GAP_UM,
        ground_tsv_offset_um=GROUND_TSV_OFFSET_UM,
    )
    coupon.plot()
```

M1 Al thickness and the 500 µm Silicon substrate come from the PDK. The 0.2 µm
TiN wall is a finite solid; its interior remains empty. These are nominal
OrPen research dimensions, not a reproduction of a cited fabrication process.

## Initialize AEDT Project / App

The selected design is Q3D. The native CLI owns initialization later during
`build_model`; no manual Desktop attachment or second client is used here.

## Simulation Configuration

```{python}
#| id: tsv-q3d-handoff
HANDOFF = None
if WORKFLOW_ACTION in {"prepare_handoff", "build_model"}:
    # Public detached record, not a claim that GeometryPlan.prepare registered these children.
    snapshot = GeometryPlanSnapshot(
        build_input, json.dumps(stack), gds_bytes, gds_sha256, tuple(source["source_occurrences"])
    )
    used_materials = {e.material_id for e in build_input.entities}
    materials = {
        name: PdkMaterial(
            material_id=name,
            kind=stack["materials"][name]["material_kind"],
            is_superconducting=stack["materials"][name]["is_superconducting"],
            library_name=stack["materials"][name]["aedt_library_name"],
        )
        for name in used_materials
    }
    HANDOFF = prepare_q3d_from_geometry(
        snapshot,
        modeling=MODEL,
        output_dir=RUN_DIR,
        project_name=PROJECT_NAME,
        design_name=DESIGN_NAME,
        materials=materials,
        net_types={"Signal": "Signal", "Ground": "Ground"},
        physical_ground_nets=("Ground",),
        run_control=RUN_CONTROL,
        region_padding_um=(px, px, py, py, pz, pz),
        resources=RESOURCES,
    )
    display(HANDOFF)
```

The detached snapshot binds the freshly exported GDS to the same source
occurrences and holes. Physical Al/TiN identities are retained; native ideal
superconductor treatment follows the PDK material declaration. `None` means
there is no Analysis Setup, extraction frequency or adaptive-pass selection.

## Solve and Export

**Model-only: no solve.** The explicit CLI action builds, reads, saves and
releases the prepared model; it never calls Analyze in this notebook.

```{python}
#| id: tsv-q3d-native
if WORKFLOW_ACTION == "build_model":
    subprocess.run(
        [
            sys.executable,
            "-m",
            "scgsim.aedt.run",
            "--handoff",
            str(HANDOFF.metadata_path),
            "--execute",
            "--prepare-only",
        ],
        check=True,
    )
```

## Adaptive-Pass Convergence / Solver Diagnostics

No adaptive pass or convergence history is expected. Keep actual native

## Results: Plots and Readable Tables

### Physics Analysis Results

No C/G matrix, field energy or electrical-continuity result is expected.
Inspect actual sheet/solid membership, Silicon bores, material and Signal/Ground
assignments. Empty or inconclusive contact queries remain unknown.

```{python}
#| id: tsv-q3d-readback

if WORKFLOW_ACTION == "inspect_model":

    display(PREPARED_MODEL.project_path)
    display(PREPARED_MODEL.readback)
```

### Simulation Performance / Benchmarks

There are no adaptive passes or solved benchmarks. Preserve preparation/save/
release provenance from the returned package; a successful model build is not
capacitance accuracy or convergence evidence.

## Save and Release AEDT

The public Prepare Only transaction saves and releases its own Desktop. Do
not open a second client to release it. Keep `.aedt` and its required unsolved
companions together; use a separate writable copy for Human edits rather than
modifying the hash-bound returned producer project. Old Solid models and images
remain historical, not outputs of this Thin Film notebook.
